content.comment_body: Hello, I am working with a [product_name] and I want to copy a program between the memory card and the [product_name], both ways. My goal is to be able to download programs without needing a programming cable. However, I'm using a pink colored memory card and when I try to copy the program from the card to the [product_name], I get a 'Copy protected' message. Can you advise if using another memory card would help, or suggest a solution with the current card? Thank you and looking forward to your reply. Thanks & Regards, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], for more details, please refer to the [product_name] manual, available at [url]. For specifications on SD cards compatible with [product_name], see the section titled 'New features of the [product_name] device series, SD card support, Note'. For copy protection details, review chapter 8.1 on security functions (CopyProtect). Program transfers are supported only between the [product_name] and SD card. You first need to transfer the program from your PC to the [product_name] using a programming cable.
Thank you for your helpful advice, it really assisted me in resolving my issue. Warm Regards, [user_name]
Hello [user_name], I'm happy to hear your problem was solved. Please consider using the 'rate' button if you found this helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: The user experienced a problem with transferring a program between a [product_name] device and a pink SD memory card due to copy protection limitations. The discussion clarified that certain memory cards have restrictions and outlined the correct procedure: first transfer the program from a PC to the [product_name] via a programming cable, then manage transfers with the SD card, as direct copy is not allowed due to protection features.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wishes to copy programs between the [product_name] device and the memory card easily, even without a programming cable, and without encountering any restrictions due to copy protection.
